$comment: Provider pack: Chrome DevTools MCP server for frontend agents. Deep-merged by deploy/merge-packs.mjs when --enable-pack chrome-devtools. Privacy flags (no telemetry, no CrUX, isolated profile) are baked into the source opencode.json command array, so this pack only flips disabled + a root permissions rule {action: "chrome-devtools*", effect: "allow"}. Requires Chrome stable installed locally.
